title: Thanks and closing remarks
summary: Dance praises his unchanged standards; Thompson thanks Helen and Stanley Dance.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, I think it's very wonderful. From the very beginning of this interview you've shown your feeling for the music and the standards that you've maintained, and here we are coming at this point and you're still feeling and thinking the same way. I think that's absolutely wonderful. The years haven't altered your viewpoint at all, have they?

No, I don't think so, in fact I think they've mellowed them. And I want to thank you, and Stanley Dance, your very fine husband, for arranging this for me. And I want to tell you how much I really appreciate it, and I hope that I'll be able to justify all of your interests by producing some more good music for you.
Well, it's been a very great pleasure, Sir Charles.
